prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE original painted-realistic editorial character portrait for Project Ulysses, a fictional Strangereal story. This is original supporting cast, never an existing Ace Combat character or a national government leader. Character: Malik Renn, Osean wingman. Appearance and mood: Early/mid twenties; warm dark-brown skin, short tightly curled black hair, dark eyes, clean-shaven, broad expressive face. Plain slate flight suit; ready warmth without a triumphal pose. Head and shoulders, gently three-quarter toward the viewer, entire hair and head comfortably inside the frame with generous headroom and shoulder margin for later portrait-card crops. Portrait aspect 4:5. Realistic natural skin, individual facial features and believable eyes, subtle painted texture and practical cloth grain. Soft natural cool daylight and restrained navy/cyan surroundings; simple blurred service-room background without a recognizable location. Plain practical 1990s clothing, no rank or name patches. No hands, weapon, permanent injury, text, lettering, numbers, logo, flag, insignia, emblem, signature, watermark, yellow paint or overlay, UI border, collage, glowing cyberpunk lights or WWII costume. Fill the full image with the portrait and background; one person only. Framing requirement: a clearly visible empty background band above the hair, roughly one tenth of the image height; camera includes the upper chest and shoulders rather than a tightly cropped face.
source_layer: User-approved original supporting fiction; not national leaders or official biography
review: Individually inspected original master: warm dark-brown skin, short tight curls, clean-shaven broad face, dark eyes and a restrained uneven warmth. Plain slate flight suit and soft service-room background. Entire head and shoulders retained with good top margin; no readable text, marks, insignia, yellow overlay or injury.
